:::::

```{=html}
<script>

const API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

async function checkServer() {

    const status = document.getElementById("server-status");

    try {

        const response = await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/health`,
            {
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000)
            }
        );

        if (response.ok) {

            const data = await response.json();

            status.innerHTML =
                `🟢 Server Online — ${data.model}`;

        } else {

            status.innerHTML =
                "🔴 Server Offline";

        }

    } catch (error) {

        status.innerHTML =
            "🔴 Server Offline";

    }
}


async function sendMessage() {

    const input =
        document.getElementById("user-message");

    const output =
        document.getElementById("chat-output");

    const message =
        input.value.trim();


    if (!message) {
        return;
    }


    output.innerHTML += `
        <p>
            <strong>You:</strong>
            ${message}
        </p>
    `;


    input.value = "";


    output.innerHTML += `
        <p id="thinking">
            <strong>Qwen:</strong>
            Thinking...
        </p>
    `;


    try {

        const response = await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/chat`,
            {
                method: "POST",

                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },

                body: JSON.stringify({
                    message: message
                })
            }
        );


        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error("Server error");
        }


        const data =
            await response.json();


        document.getElementById(
            "thinking"
        ).remove();


        output.innerHTML += `
            <p>
                <strong>Qwen:</strong>
                ${data.response}
            </p>
        `;


    } catch (error) {

        const thinking =
            document.getElementById("thinking");

        if (thinking) {
            thinking.remove();
        }


        output.innerHTML += `
            <p>
                🔴 AI server unavailable.
            </p>
        `;

    }
}


checkServer();

setInterval(
    checkServer,
    15000
);

</script>
```
